I will perform a comprehensive valuation analysis for AAPL, MSFT, and GOOGL, utilizing both DCF and multiples analysis. I will then compare their valuations and identify which company appears most attractive and least attractive based on these metrics.

First, I will get the current market data for AAPL, MSFT, and GOOGL.
Then, I will calculate the DCF valuation for each company. Given the "Risk-On" macro environment with easing liquidity, rising inflation, and rising GDP, I will use a discount rate of 9% (slightly higher than a neutral rate to account for inflation but still reflecting easing liquidity) and a growth rate of 10% for the projection years, with a terminal growth rate of 3% for all three companies, reflecting their strong growth prospects in a rising GDP environment.
After that, I will calculate the multiple valuation for each company.
Finally, I will calculate the margin of safety for each company using the current price and the base-case intrinsic value from the DCF analysis.
I will then present a comparative analysis and ranking based on these valuations.
